svg.aria-label: Cycle time: how long each item waited to be closed (log scale)
svg.text: Cycle time: how long each item waited to be closed (log scale)
One dot per closed item, placed when it closed. Norm's items are Greg's deliveries and questions (Greg files no asks). Lines: rolling p50/p90 of 9.
Norm: deliveries, questions (p50 4 min, p90 8 min, n=79)
Greg: asks (p50 28 min, p90 1.4 h, n=128)
